title: A comprehensive review of the medicinal properties of Terminalia arjuna and its major constituent arjunolic acid: a natural product source for new drug leads
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,23217-23256
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA02419J, Review Article
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Manohar Bhujel, Sai Giridhar Sarma Kandanur, Lakshminath Sripada, Nageswara Rao Golakoti
This review comprehensively compiles and discusses the literature related to T. arjuna, arjunolic acid and its derivatives, in particular focusing on their, medicinal properties, and mechanism of biological activities.
